bias.confirmation: Wait for one side to be swept; the reclaim and displacement define direction
bias.method: Monthly → weekly → daily narrative; Asia supplies the intraday manipulation map.

asia.name: Asian range
asia.qualityNote: Compact accumulation range; suitable for watching a one-sided raid.

playbook.verdict: Let London reveal the first raid; trade only a reclaim plus structure shift.
steps: Manipulation: watch Either edge for the first meaningful liquidity raid.
Confirmation: require a directional 5m displacement and market-structure shift back through the range.
Distribution: use Opposite Asian edge as the first objective, then the higher-timeframe draw.
playbook.noTradeIf: Both Asian edges are swept, price never reclaims the raided edge, or high-impact news is imminent.
